A generic 'Shiv Temple' is listed at Bhuna (meta.ai, coords 29.536113, 75.704983), which may or may not be the intended referent. This entry is a thin local-shrine placeholder. name: Bhuna Shiv Temple
town_description: Bhuna is a small town in Fatehabad district, Haryana (PIN 125111), about 26 km from Fatehabad and 18 km from Uklana. According to local tradition it was founded by Bhun Singh, son of Raja Bhim; it is best known for the temple of Baba Ranadhir, which draws followers from across the country.
